newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: CRICKET-ZIMBABWE WIN TOSS, PUT INDIA IN TO BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ZIMBABWE WIN TOSS, PUT INDIA IN TO BAT.

text.p: Zimbabwe captain Alistair Campbell won the toss and put India in to bat in the first one-day international at Queens Sports Club on Saturday.
The match has been reduced from 50 to 44 overs after intermittent rain and poor light delayed the start of play by 45 minutes.
Zimbabwe - Grant Flower, Andy Waller, Alistair Campbell (captain), Guy Whittall, Andy Flower, Dave Houghton, Craig Evans, Paul Strang, Heath Streak, Eddo Brandes, John Rennie.
India - Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Saurav Ganguly, Vikram Rathore, Mohammad Azharuddin, Ajay Jadeja, Robin Singh, Nayan Mongia, Sunil Joshi, Anil Kumble, Doda Ganesh, Venkatesh Prasad.
